_notes.dates: ISO strings; meeting dates may contain fractional times (Excel serial fractions) e.g. 2028-02-07T14:24:00
_notes.errors: Excel error values kept as strings like '#VALUE!', '#N/A', '#DIV/0!'; NaN/blank RTD values -> null
_notes.rate_SOFR/rate_EFFR: full 1000-row history tables 'rate'!A:B and D:E (sorted newest first)
_notes.ZQ_1MS: row label 'Oct26' means the Oct26-Nov26 1M calendar spread (bp)
_notes.units: outright prices in price points (e.g. 96.1174); spreads (ZQ_MS, ZQ_1MS, SR1ZQ, SR3_3MS, SR3SR1 structure) in bp
